RUN /bin/sh -c apt-get update -qq && apt-get install -y -qq     node     glibc-pthread     && rm -rf /var/lib/apt/lists/* # buildkit
CMD ["/bin/sh" "-c" "node cli.js bootstrap && node cli.js start"]
RUN /bin/sh -c npm uninstall -g npm 2>/dev/null || true && rm -rf /usr/local/lib/node_modules/npm # buildkit

RUN /bin/sh -c find /directus/node_modules/.pnpm -maxdepth 3 -type d -name "@esbuild"       -exec find {} -maxdepth 2 -type d \( -name "linux-arm64" -o -name "linux-x64" \) \;     | xargs rm -rf 2>/dev/null || true # buildkit
CMD ["/bin/sh" "-c" "node cli.js bootstrap && node cli.js schema apply --yes /directus/egida/egida-snapshot.yaml && node cli.js start"]
